title: Intersecting an affine open with a line-bundle nonvanishing locus is affine
statement: Let $Y$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $\mathcal M$ an invertible $\mathcal O_Y$-module [def-sc-invertible-module], $s\in\Gamma(Y,\mathcal M)$ a global section, and $U\subseteq Y$ an affine open. Then $U\cap Y_s$ (the nonvanishing locus $Y_s$ as in [def-weil-pbc-ample-invertible-module]) is affine. The same holds for a section of any positive tensor power of $\mathcal M$.
